sents.t: In January, a big winter storm hit Oakville.
On Tuesday, the weather report said, “Two feet of snow are coming tonight. Please stay home.” That afternoon, the supermarket was very busy.
People were buying bread, milk, batteries, and candles.
Rosa was visiting Danny for a few days, so Max was staying with me.
When the snow started, I was watching a movie and Max was sleeping on my sofa.
The power was off in the whole building.
It was completely dark and very quiet.
Then someone knocked on my door.
It was Mr. Brooks, our landlord.
He was carrying a box of blankets.
“Are you OK, Sam? The heat isn’t working, so take these,” he said.
I slept in my jacket and hat with Max next to me.
In the morning, the power came back.
Everything outside was white, and the cars were under the snow.
The schools and the bookstore were closed.
My neighbors and I shoveled the sidewalk together, and then we built a snowman with a carrot nose.

What were people buying at the supermarket?
What was Sam doing when the snow started?
